description:
Review and Fix Status Maps UI Issues

Investigate and resolve multiple UI and functional issues in the status maps interface related to visibility, scrolling, and service status display.

Issues to Address:

1. Password Option Visibility
   - Password option is currently hidden in the UI
   - Container is not scrollable, preventing access to hidden content
   - Ensure all configuration options are visible and accessible
   - Add proper scrolling behavior if content exceeds viewport

2. Service Status Display Problem
   - Status page incorrectly shows "services unavailable" 
   - Verify if this is a display issue or actual connectivity problem
   - Check data fetching and rendering logic for service status

3. Ping/Monitoring Architecture Clarification
   - Determine if status page relies on existing app-level ping monitoring
   - Investigate if status page has its own independent pinging feature
   - Document the current monitoring architecture
   - Ensure no duplicate or conflicting health check implementations

Acceptance Criteria:
- All status map configuration options are visible and accessible
- Scrolling works properly when content overflows
- Service status accurately reflects actual service availability
- Clear understanding of ping/monitoring responsibilities documented
- UI displays correct real-time status for all monitored services
title: Fix status maps UI scrolling and service visibility issues
